prompt: I just merged a bunch of fixes into main and I want to get a new build out to my testers on TestFlight. Can you walk me through the whole thing? I'd rather use the CLI if possible but tell me when I need to go to a website.

assertions.text: Runs or recommends `eas build --platform ios --profile production`
Explains how to monitor the build (eas build:list or the build URL)
Runs or recommends `eas submit --platform ios --profile production --latest`
Mentions the --auto-submit flag as a shortcut to combine build+submit
Explains that Apple processing takes 5-30 minutes after submission
Tells the user to verify the build in TestFlight / App Store Connect
Clearly separates what can be done via CLI vs what requires a browser
